proposed_action: Enable an opt-in default for personalized content recommendations for all users in the EU region.
raw_reasoning:
Explain your reasoning in 2 to 4 sentences. Consider whose data or rights are affected, and whether they would reasonably expect to be asked first.
The proposed action directly affects EU users' personal data used for building recommendation profiles, which falls under GDPR's strict rules for processing personal data for personalized purposes. Users have a reasonable expectation of being asked before their data is used in this way, especially since "personalized content recommendations" typically requires affirmative consent rather than a default-on setting. While the action mentions "opt-in default," enabling any form of personalization processing still generally requires obtaining explicit, informed consent first rather than assuming it can be toggled on by default for the region. This protects user privacy rights and autonomy over their data.
